body: Not sure what to label this because it is more general than Panache since even Hibernate methods are missing. Also, not sure how to debug this without a Windows machine.

I also reproduce this issue on my Windows10 pro with my JDK (AdoptOpenJdk).

Is there a way to activate some debug logs in quarkus:build phase to help you to debug the problem?

I have launched both Maven build in debug mode (with @maebl's JDK : Amazon Coretto).
Main differences are at the end of `quarkus-maven-plugin:0.14.0:build`

On linux, we have:
```
[INFO] [io.quarkus.deployment.QuarkusAugmentor] Quarkus augmentation completed in ¤¤¤¤ms
[DEBUG] [org.hibernate.bytecode.enhance.spi.Enhancer] Enhancing [org.acme.hibernate.orm.panache.Fruit] as Entity
[DEBUG] [org.hibernate.bytecode.enhance.spi.Enhancer] Weaving in PersistentAttributeInterceptable implementation on [org.acme.hibernate.orm.panache.Fruit]
[DEBUG] [org.hibernate.bytecode.enhance.internal.bytebuddy.PersistentAttributeTransformer] Found @MappedSuperclass class io.quarkus.hibernate.orm.panache.PanacheEntity to collectPersistenceFields
[DEBUG] [org.hibernate.bytecode.enhance.internal.bytebuddy.PersistentAttributeTransformer] Persistent fields for entity org.acme.hibernate.orm.panache.Fruit: [org.hibernate.bytecode.enhance.internal.bytebuddy.EnhancerImpl$AnnotatedFieldDescription@¤¤¤¤¤¤¤¤, org.hibernate.bytecode.enhance.internal.bytebuddy.EnhancerImpl$AnnotatedFieldDescription@¤¤¤¤¤¤¤¤]
[INFO] [io.quarkus.creator.phase.runnerjar.RunnerJarPhase] Building jar: quarkus-quickstarts/hibernate-orm-panache-resteasy/target/hibernate-orm-panache-resteasy-1.0-SNAPSHOT-runner.jar
```
On Windows:
```
[INFO] [io.quarkus.deployment.QuarkusAugmentor] Quarkus augmentation completed in ¤¤¤¤ms
[INFO] [io.quarkus.creator.phase.runnerjar.RunnerJarPhase] Building jar: quarkus-quickstarts/hibernate-orm-panache-resteasy/target/hibernate-orm-panache-resteasy-1.0-SNAPSHOT-runner.jar
```

So on Windows, `org.hibernate.bytecode.enhance...` is not launched.

For more information, normalized partial Maven logs:
* [mvn-windows.normalized.log](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/files/3165741/mvn-windows.normalized.log)
* [mvn-linux.normalized.log](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/files/3165742/mvn-linux.normalized.log)

I also reproduce this issue on project: quarkus-quickstarts/hibernate-orm-resteasy (project without Panache)

And I also reproduce, of course, this problem on my own project when I compile in my Windows environment.
